name: Sanaüja (Spain)
description: White field with three red zigzag (dancetty) horizontal stripes.
history: The official flag of Sanaüja is of heraldic origin: oblong, of proportions two high by three long, white, with three red viperate fesses of thickness 1/7 of the height of the cloth, each with six and a half teeth above and five and a half below; these are the arms of the Sanaüja family, lords of the castle of the town. The arms were approved on 23 October 1997 and the flag on 23 March 1999, published in the DOGC on 26 April 1999 with a correction on 8 March 2001.

features.role: three viperate (dancetty) stripes of 1/7 of the height
